Internal helper: parse a text variable's labels string

Source: R/recode.R
dot-jst_parse_text_labels.Rd

"REF=Refused; UNKNOWN=Unknown" into a named character vector (names the labels, values the strings), for jdeclare_missing() on a text variable (Slate E5, ruling R26's lean 3). The value is read up to the first equals sign; quoted, it may hold = or ;, and its text is kept as typed, outer spaces included – a declared value matches as stored. Bare, it is trimmed, and blank names the blank cells, as in jencode()'s maps ("blank" in quotes is the word). The label is read as ruling R17 reads one.

Usage

.jst_parse_text_labels(labels_str)

Arguments

labels_str

The labels string.

Value

Named character vector.
